name: app-new-habits-goal-tracking-invitation-pink-black-quadrant-blue-phone
title: 'New App New Habits' invitation with a pink-black quadrant background and a blue phone showing a routine ring
whatItIs: A pink invitation split into black and cream quadrant blocks, with a bold 'NEW APP NEW HABITS' headline, a small 'S' logo, an electric-blue phone mockup showing a '25 MIN' progress ring and a routine timeline (Wake Up, Running, Yoga), body copy, a download link and a bold '#NewHabits' hashtag footer.
whatItMeans: Bold and motivating; the high-contrast quadrant background makes a calm habit-tracking app announcement feel energetic and current.
techniques: Split a background into contrasting quadrant blocks.
Show one clear hero metric (a progress ring) on the app screen.
Anchor the invitation with a bold branded hashtag footer.

vocabulary.definition: A layout split into four contrasting colour or texture blocks.
A vertical list of scheduled activities with times.
